pcs.pc_description: identify and select from various types of fibers for charkha spinning, Types: Upland, long-stapled cotton, cashmere, camel down, angora etc
comb the kapas to aerate the fiber smoothly by hand using fish jaw brush/to separate all other fibers use suitable combing device such as metal comb.
undertake ginning process of the kapas manually using an iron rod
clean and fluff out ginned cotton using handmade bow
perform parallization of fibers manually
perform separation of the fibers using manually operated carding machine
carry out slivering of the fibers using a tapered wooden stick
roll the sliver suitably to carry out spinning
calculate the desired yarn count
add leader to the spindle to start the spinning process
identify the different basic positions for spindle spinning Positions: Hand in front of spindle, hand above spindle, and hand at an angle
wind the thread on the spindle tip
add twist to strengthen and compress the drafted yarn into thin strand
spin the yarn under supervision at a comfortable rate until the fibers lock together
draft the cotton off the leader
convert the spun yarn into hank
wind in a criss-cross winding pattern using hand and feet to prepare the hank

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the drive belt in the new model charkha allows the flyer to move freely
adjust the break (draw-in) to rest on the bobbin
ensure that the size of the wheel is inversely proportional to the diameter of the whorl for faster movement of the flyer
identify and select from various types of fibers for charkha spinning, Types: Upland, long- stapled cotton, cashmere, camel down, angora, ultrafine merino, etc.
fluff out commercial cotton roving bobbin to aerate the fiber smoothly
perform the cleaning of roving bobbin
calculate the desired yarn count
wind the thread on the spindle tip
adjust the cot and apron to provide uniform pressure on the fibre strand to facilitate efficient drafting
check aprons have better grip & control on fibres particularly floating fibres
use the ring to guide the circular run of the traveller
ensure the traveller twist the drafted strand of fibres, winds yarn onto the bobbin, maintains winding tension of the yarn by the frictional resistance between the ring and traveller
check the creel holds the roving bobbin over a roller beam within a convenient height to easily handle the roving
ensure the spindle holds the bobbin tight enough to prevent any slippage, and winds the twisted thread on the bobbin with the help of ring and traveller
add twist per inch if thread keeps drifting apart (breaking)
ensure the twist does not get into the drafting area
change the hooks frequently to avoid thread pile up in one spot on the bobbin

modules.module_title: Ensuring proper maintenance of solar attachment

pcs.pc_description: check periodically for the working of light indicators and display panel for voltage fluctuation
ensure that the battery is kept at a dry place
check the electrolyte level of battery and top up the electrolyte whenever required
check for electrolyte/ distilled water leak from batteries
clean the battery at prescribed intervals for fluff accumulation
clean the inverter, battery charger and charge controller for fiber dust
inspect and ensure the cleanliness of solar panel and terminal boxes
use PPEs while topping up of distilled water and cleaning
use appropriate tools such as cloth, brush for cleaning various parts of the power system
